name: Maiv Flower and Vegetable Farm
description: Maiv Flower and Vegetable Farm grows Squash, Peppers, Asparagus, Peas, and Herbs in Eau Claire, WI. The farm is independent, and its seasons run through spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – May in this growing zone.
